samples.summary: Design doc updated in one section but left contradicting itself elsewhere. The new § Clear formatting text says `href`/`image`/`pageNumber` survive, yet the same doc's Editor API block (line 507: "Remove every inline style attribute from the current selection.") and its Testing section (line 732: "`clearInlineFormatting()` removes every inline attribute on the range") still state the old, now-wrong contract. Plan item 4 of the todo asked for the § Clear formatting update; these two sibling statements in the canonical subsystem doc were missed, so the doc now gives two answers to the same question. Cost stays inside the codebase (doc accuracy), hence minor.
samples.evidence: docs/design/docs/docs-font-controls.md:507 `Remove every inline style attribute from the current selection.`; :732 `clearInlineFormatting() removes every inline attribute on the range`

samples.summary: Comment contradicts the new definition this change establishes. `CLEAR_INLINE_STYLE`'s doc comment (types.ts:286-290) now explicitly says `href` is NOT structural — "the first two also make the run structural… a linked run is ordinary text carrying a content attribute" — but the format-painter comment, edited in this same diff, still asserts "`image`, `pageNumber` and `href` are dropped: they are structural inline kinds". The diff touched the very next sentence of that comment, so the inconsistency is introduced knowingly and blurs the vocabulary (`isStructuralInline`) the change is trying to sharpen.

The pending-inline-style design doc's stated outcome for the collapsed-caret path — "`clearInlineFormatting` on collapsed + typing → typed run is plain" (line 273) — is no longer literally true after this change: the pending style staged from `CLEAR_INLINE_STYLE` no longer carries `href: undefined`, so a caret parked inside a linked run now keeps the link on subsequently typed text (the trailing-edge case is still handled separately by text-editor.ts:5910-5922). The behaviour looks intended by issue #1051, but the sibling design doc that documents this exact path was not updated alongside docs-font-controls.md.
